readOnly.banner: The service is read-only right now. You can look around, but changes can't be saved until it's back.

maintenance.title: Down for maintenance
maintenance.description: The service is being worked on and will be back shortly. This page checks again by itself, so you don't need to do anything.

switch.hint: Maintenance can only be ended from an operator tenant. This session is in {{tenant}}.

operator.stillOn: The mode is still on. It is set in the deployment's environment (APP_MODE), so it can only be changed there.
operator.hint: Operators only. If the mode is set in the deployment's environment (APP_MODE), it can only be changed there.

maintenance.title: Enable maintenance for every tenant?
maintenance.description: This will replace the signed-in app with the maintenance notice for every tenant, including your session. An operator can select “End maintenance” on the notice from the operator tenant; APP_MODE settings set in the deployment environment must be changed there.

read-only.title: Make every tenant read-only?
read-only.description: Saving this blocks writes in every tenant and displays a read-only banner. An operator can restore normal mode from deployment settings; an APP_MODE override must be changed in the environment.
